t1.text: 1. Getting in: register, sign in, land on the setup assistant

p1.text:
Parity, getting in
- Register stays a request (POST /site/messages), Employer type gives hire
- Login: password, SSO button, sso_only, two-step, temporary password change, forgot and reset, SSO callback
- First sign-in lands on the setup assistant
- Setup steps come from the dashboard flags the api already returns; each step shows to whoever can do it
- Disabled actions say why
- Today keeps LiveNow (SSE), upcoming sittings, counts
- Needs your attention: decisions waiting, ready to release, stations to review
- Supervisor: circuits they lead (SupervisorCircuits), stations to review (LiveMarkingSidebar reads)
- Nav: Home, Run (Sittings, Now running, Results), Organise (People, Exams), Insight (Reporting), Settings. Every old URL still resolves

p2.text:
Parity, Exams
- Tabs keep Marking schemes, Station layouts and Programmes lists (advanced)
- Wizard calls create exam, publish, create programme, PATCH active; a failed step resumes by name
- Adopt from OSCE Guide (import gives an active programme)
- Exam settings, timings, retire, reactivate, delete (draft only)
- Station: from a layout, PDF or Word import, AI from a brief, blank, copy to my organisation
- Builder tabs, trial mark, draft instructions, preview, versions, photos, reading brief, fact check, approve, reports: all kept
- Station templates = Station layouts: start from 9 starting layouts or AI, sections, fields, who sees each field, save draft, publish, versions
- Feedback templates were merged into marking schemes (/feedback-templates redirects to rubrics): the Feedback layout tab is that template

p3.text:
Parity, stations
- New station: from a layout, PDF or Word import, AI from a prompt, blank, copy from OSCE Guide
- Builder: every section with who sees it, photos, reading brief, publish (no-brief warning), trial mark, preview, AI redraft, fact check, versions, revision history, used by, new draft version, archive, delete draft
- Approve / withdraw approval: platform staff only
- Layouts: new, edit, publish, archive, delete draft, copy

p4.text:
Parity, People
- Tabs: Trainees, Staff, Groups and year groups, Exam access, History; /team still resolves
- Every row action: resend, temporary password, revoke, restore, delete, wipe, change role
- CSV: BOM, delimiter detection, create missing cohorts, batches of 500
- Bulk bar: Move to year group, Add to group, Resend, Revoke
- New: staff bulk revoke via memberships/bulk/revoke
- Last admin protection kept
- New: Exam access tab (practice-access routes have no screen today)

p5.text:
Parity, scheduling
- Wizard: create sitting, then circuits/bulk (formal) or circuits (training); failure lands on the sitting with retry
- Only Ready to schedule exams; max 12 stations formal; training needs trainees = stations
- Groups, year groups and people; pending invite shows reason + Resend
- Per-break lengths 1-60, timings per circuit
- Supervisor: one for all, or per candidate
- Sitting page keeps Add a circuit, Edit circuit, reorder, late joiners (training), cancel, delete circuit, set date, console, results
- New: edit year group on the sitting
- Sittings list keeps status, kind, exam, date and name filters, load more, Next up
- Edit circuit: lock reasons and stale-revision reload

p6.text:
Parity, exam day
- Live board: SSE, worker-down warning, recording-missing and overdue notices, Earlier by day
- Console: every control asks for a reason (pause, extend 1-3600 s, reset, resend, end, jump, redo), auto-advance, station progress, station content, listen in (exam listen-only; training camera and mic), add trainee (training), interventions log
- Candidate: auto-join during reading, mic preflight, join refusals, reading brief, station list, feedback when ready

p7.text:
Parity, marking
- Supervisor: your marks (draft, withdraw, submit); admin: admin's review with per-domain notes, overall, revision, conflict
- Automatic marking states and Retry, transcript load and download (named supervisor only), reviewers' agreement, candidate stepper
- Publish circuit feedback is the manual finalise step

p8.text:
Parity, Results
- Results tabs, sitting results, SlotReview controls, senior review, preview before release, PDF, bulk release, back to draft, candidate acknowledgement, CSV and readout exports
- Publish circuit feedback explained as the finalise step
- Candidate: outcome, by station, PDF, I have read this; not released and not marked states

p9.text:
Parity, insight and settings
- Reporting: one row per exam, pass rate on released decisions; per-sitting CSV and readout on Results
- Settings keeps name, read-only web address, SSO status (read only), two-step status, SCIM tokens, profile, two-factor, data download, delete account, preferences
- Invoices (new): list, detail, PO number on existing /orgs/{slug}/invoices routes. Money: needs your review and a security review

p10.text:
Parity, roles
- Hire: same structure, words from useAssessWords (Candidate, Assessment, Assessor); Programmes reachable under Exams
- Hiring outcome on decisions kept
- Trainee nav unchanged: Home, My sittings, Results, Self practice, Practice sessions
- Trainee: practice history (transcripts, debriefs), practice sessions (/mocks)
- Partner unchanged: dashboard tabs, reporting, team
- Not institution: Library and Discussion are train-only (404 on assess)

intro.text: Read left to right, top to bottom: the order a new administrator meets each screen. Every primary button links to the next board. Same blue and quiet tokens as today; hire changes words only. Each board ends with a blue note listing what it keeps from today.
